title: Apophatic Anglicans and Holy Agnosis
excerpt: My upcoming (March 2011) book Naked Spirituality is an exploration of the spiritual life … in four seasons or stages from simplicity to harmony. Becky G and Carl M offer some good food for thought regarding what I describe as the fourth season here.
